mapper.select: WITH resident_stats AS ( SELECT ra.room_id, COUNT(*) AS active_residents, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.bed_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_beds FROM room_assignment ra WHERE ra.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ra.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY ra.room_id ), bed_stats AS ( SELECT bed.room_id, SUM(CASE WHEN bed.operational_status = 'ENABLED' AND occupied.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available_beds FROM bed LEFT JOIN room_assignment occupied ON occupied.room_id = bed.room_id AND occupied.bed_id = bed.id AND occupied.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE bed.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY bed.room_id ) SELECT r.id, r.room_number, r.room_type, r.capacity, r.gender_restriction, r.resident_scope, r.operational_status, r.state_version, f.floor_number, b.id AS building_id, b.building_code, b.building_name, COALESCE(residents.active_residents, 0) AS active_residents, COALESCE(residents.unknown_beds, 0) AS unknown_beds, COALESCE(beds.available_beds, 0) AS available_beds, NULL AS conflict_batch_id, NULL AS conflict_batch_name, NULL AS conflict_selection_mode FROM room r JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = f.building_id LEFT JOIN resident_stats residents ON residents.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN bed_stats beds ON beds.room_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{roomId}

WITH scoped_beds AS ( SELECT scope.bed_id FROM batch_bed_scope scope JOIN bed scoped_bed ON scoped_bed.id = scope.bed_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND scoped_bed.room_id = #{roomId} UNION SELECT bed.id FROM batch_room_scope scope JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = scope.room_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND scope.room_id = #{roomId} UNION SELECT bed.id FROM batch_building_scope scope JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id = scope.building_id JOIN room room_scope ON room_scope.floor_id = floor.id JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = room_scope.id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND room_scope.id = #{roomId} ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_beds scoped JOIN bed ON bed.id = scoped.bed_id LEFT JOIN room_assignment occupied ON occupied.room_id = bed.room_id AND occupied.bed_id = bed.id AND occupied.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE bed.operational_status = 'ENABLED' AND occupied.id IS NULL
